notes: Tier 1: the skill's local (no-git) behavior — the fidelity contract (SKILL-IMPL-001) and detection-absent path (SKILL-DETECT-002), exercising the SYNC-*/CMD-*/FMT-* specs the skill shares with the binary. Every fixture writes plain files with no backlog/.git, so each run is also a SKILL-DETECT-002 case (the skill must edit in place and run no git). The two start-* evals assume the harness runs with HOME (or XDG_CONFIG_HOME) pointed at the fixture root so .config/vat/config.toml is read as the user config. The claim-loop specs (SKILL-GUARD/LOOP/TERM/CFG) are NOT covered here — they need a real nested-repo + upstream + controlled contention rig and are tracked as a separate backlog item. Binary-first delegation (SKILL-BIN-*) does not change these assertions: whether the skill runs `vat <command>` (binary present) or the prose procedure (binary absent), the resulting file state is byte-identical and the ordinary-backlog path runs no git either way — so every fixture's expected outcome holds regardless of whether the binary is installed in the eval environment.
